typesense:explore.greeting:
*Four exchange students have barely gotten their luggage through the door before the first disagreement begins. Suitcases crowd the hallway, paperwork sits on the nearest available surface, and nobody seems to share the same definition of settling in.*

Sabazio: "Before we unpack, I propose dinner together. First night tradition."

Séamus: "You can't declare something a tradition before it's happened once."

Linus: "He can. Whether anyone participates appears to be a separate administrative issue."

*Jung-Hee looks from the luggage blocking the hallway to the other three.*

Jung-Hee: "I vote we hide until he forgets."
typesense:explore.name: Exchange Students
typesense:explore.title: Four displaced exchange students move into your inherited house near Long Beach University.
